text:
incident-bot: ALERT: trace_export_errors spike > 40% over 5m for service: inference-runtime. Possible downstream ingestion failures (vendor: Honeycomb). Paging on-call.

maria_sre: on it, looking at traces ingestion dashboard now. seeing huge 5xx from export proxies to honeycomb-eu. Not seeing increased request errors in API.

sanjay_oncall: ack. paging lucas and jessica. tagging @pm-arthur for customer impact visibility.

jessica_obs: confirm: traces are failing to deliver. span counts dropped ~60% after 1859998800. Logs show repeated HTTP 502/503 from honeycomb edge.

lucas_eng_runtime: checking runtime side — OTLP exporter is healthy, queue backlog rising. KV cache still fine. no ETA on retry throughput because backoff is kicking in.

kate_support: any customer-facing alerts? Support getting tickets about missing traces in customer dashboards.

pm-arthur: are customers losing API functionality or just observability? Need to prepare comms if critical customers affected.

maria_sre: so far only telemetry loss. No impact to latency or errors in user requests. we should still treat as Sev2 until ingestion restored.

sanjay_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) fail fast exporter to avoid queue explosion 2) reduce sampling to 1% for traces 3) route export to secondary endpoint (if available) 4) open vendor ticket. executing now.

lucas_eng_runtime: applying sampling override patch to the runtime via feature-flag workspace:

```
# override sampling env
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=probabilistic
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.01
```

lucas_eng_runtime: pushed canary to 10% of pods now (deployment inference-runtime v3.2.7 -> canary). watching queue depth.

jessica_obs: created honeycomb alert: ingestion 5xx > 5% and trace-gaps > 30% for 10m. preparing correlation dashboard for support to attach to tickets.

honeycomb-support: (automated) Ticket HNY-83422 created: "europe ingestion 502s". Engaging ingestion team, investigating upstream gateway.

maria_sre: while vendor triages, enabling local sink (disk-backed) for critical spans and short TTL to avoid memory OOMs.

lucas_eng_runtime: config snippet for local sink:

```
exporter.local.enabled=true
exporter.local.path=/var/otlp-staging
exporter.local.max_size_mb=512
exporter.local.ttl_seconds=900
```

kate_support: I'm drafting a short customer note: "We are currently experiencing partial loss of distributed tracing due to a third-party vendor ingestion issue. No user-facing errors reported. We will update when exports resume." Sending to watchlist.

sanjay_oncall: honeycomb responded: "we are seeing gateway errors from our EU edge for a subset of requests, mitigation in progress. please consider alternate region or retry-after."

lucas_eng_runtime: trying a fallback to honeycomb-us endpoint via env override on a small cohort. If successful, will gradually shift more traffic.

maria_sre: to confirm, we will NOT change production routing for customer data without PM/legal signoff — but switching exporter endpoint for internal debug/traces-only cohort is fine.

pm-arthur: ack. keep me posted. I'll prep a customer-facing timeline if we need to extend SLA windows.

jessica_obs: after canary switch to us endpoint, we started to see successful deliveries for subset of pods. trace delivery rate bumped to ~85% in canary group.

honeycomb-support: update: issue isolated to an internal proxy in EU. rolling config fix, estimated resolution 20-30 minutes from 1859999400.

sanjay_oncall: next steps: keep sampling low, keep local sink enabled, continue gradual fallback if vendor can't commit to region fix. add postmortem owner and remind SLO team about metric gaps.

maria_sre: handing off to night oncall @sanjay_oncall in 20m. sanjay, please monitor vendor updates and sampling state, and post an incident summary in #postmortems when resolved.

sanjay_oncall: taking handoff. current state summary:
- Root cause: Honeycomb EU ingestion proxy returning 502/503
- Impact: trace export failures and gaps, no API customer errors
- Mitigations applied: sampling reduced to 1%, local disk sink enabled, fallback to us endpoint for canary pods
- Vendor ticket: HNY-83422 (in progress)
- Customer comms: support note posted to watchlist
- Next: monitor for full restoration, preserve logs and span samples for postmortem

kate_support: flagged top-5 customers with high trace reliance; sending direct notes now.

honeycomb-support: update at 1859999680: fix deployed to EU gateway, ingestion rates returning to normal. recommend clients drain queues and resume normal sampling.

lucas_eng_runtime: rolling back sampling override now to previous 10% (prod baseline). will also disable local sink after queues are drained.

jessica_obs: confirming span counts back to baseline in most regions. opening a data-quality check to ensure no lasting gaps.

maria_sre: incident resolved for now. please keep ticket open until postmortem. assigning postmortem to lucas_eng_runtime & jessica_obs.

sanjay_oncall: incident closed at 1859999800. follow-ups: vendor RCA, update runbook with "fallback endpoint" instructions, add automated failover to secondary exporter, and add sampling override playbook to oncall runbook.

pm-arthur: thanks all. will coordinate customer postmortem note after internal writeup.
